dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Saints Drop to 3-7 After Bears Loss, Prepare for Bengals Test
dailyTopNewsBrief.summary: New Orleans fell to 3-7 following a 21-13 Week 11 loss to Chicago, marked by pass protection struggles and offensive inconsistency. Head coach Kellen Moore and quarterback Tyler Shough voiced confidence in the team's direction ahead of a demanding Week 12 matchup against the 7-2 Cincinnati Bengals.
bullets: Quarterback Tyler Shough expressed firm belief in head coach Kellen Moore despite New Orleans dropping its second straight game to fall to 3-7 ([Katherine Terrell](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50566404/tyler-shough-confident-new-orleans-saints-kellen-moore)).

The Saints surrendered three sacks to Chicago All-Pro defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons in a 21-13 home defeat where familiar execution mistakes stalled momentum ([ESPN Staff](https://www.espn.com/nfl/recap?gameId=401873071)).

Kicker Charlie Smyth hit a 51-yard fourth-quarter field goal, providing a scoring highlight as New Orleans tried to narrow Chicago's late lead ([Saints Media](https://www.neworleanssaints.com/video/charlie-smyth-field-goal-saints-vs-bears-highlights)).

New Orleans faces a formidable Week 12 road test without offensive linemen Erik McCoy (biceps) and Taliese Fuaga (knee), confronting a Bengals offense ranking top-three in scoring and passing EPA ([neworleanssaints.com](https://www.neworleanssaints.com/news/chicago-bears-new-orleans-saints-2026-nfl-week-11-game-recap)).
